question: Jama Masjid in Delhi was built by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shah Jahan** was the **Mughal emperor** from **1628 to 1658 **and commissioned the construction of** Jama Masjid in Delhi in 1650. **
 
• Jama Masjid is one of the largest mosques in India and can accommodate up to **25,000 worshippers at a time.**
 
• It is located in the old city of **Delhi near the famous Red Fort and** was completed in **1656.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Khilji** was a powerful ruler of the **Delhi Sultanate in the 14th century** and is known for his military conquests and administrative reforms.
 
• **Akbar **was a famous Mughal emperor who ruled from **1556 to 1605 **and is known for his religious tolerance and cultural patronage.
 
• **Sikandar Lodi **was a ruler of the **Delhi Sultanate in the 16th century **and is known for his architectural achievements, such as the construction of the Lodi Gardens in Delhi.
